decisions.reason: Different canonical complete.json/run_key/timeline and audio.jobs reader contracts; donor scanner supports PCM16 only. Our selected current AudioRuntime extends all accepted integer widths to s32 without precision loss, retains the existing typed Studio/Book/Director guards and shared broker/absolute deadline. Importing a parallel donor service would duplicate those authorities.

Both implementations use every-channel inclusive amplitude comparison, exact decimal-ceil minimum frames, maximal half-open ranges and complete omitted counts; these general semantics were already present in our reviewed source.

decisions.changes: Use existing real AudioRuntime decode to s32; four decoded bytes/channel instead of two PCM16 bytes. Threshold -192 gives integer zero. Retain the same eight zero frames spanning the actual1MiB boundary, exact range/count and original hash; also verify full decoded hash. Two cases appended; preceding39 cases exact prefix.

decisions.reason: Different current controller and module contracts. Our same existing Scene worker and CLI now delegate to the admitted service; source-bound Book and primary Director wrappers remain on existing owners. Extra report-export mutations are outside this approved warning-only slice.
Depend on donor timeline schema and are not acoustic proof. Our current canonical receipts/identity guards are verified; findings deliberately do not infer intended pauses or speech presence.
Separate helper architecture and failure; no corresponding receiving defect established by this reuse check. Existing receiving owned-process/retained-context rules remain.
